MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY OCTOBER — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY OCTOBER
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Taxonomy? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Taxonomy.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Taxonomy.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Taxonomy.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Taxonomy.

3. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Removing all vegetation

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Taxonomy 1.2 Fish Physiology 2.0 Aquaculture 2.1 Fish cage 2.2 Fish Harvest? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Taxonomy 1.2 Fish Physiology 2.0 Aquaculture 2.1 Fish cage 2.2 Fish Harvest.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Taxonomy 1.2 Fish Physiology 2.0 Aquaculture 2.1 Fish cage 2.2 Fish Harvest.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Taxonomy 1.2 Fish Physiology 2.0 Aquaculture 2.1 Fish cage 2.2 Fish Harvest.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Taxonomy 1.2 Fish Physiology 2.0 Aquaculture 2.1 Fish cage 2.2 Fish Harvest.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Physiology? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Physiology.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Physiology.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Physiology.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Physiology.

6. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Producers
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Decomposers only

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Value Addition? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Value Addition.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Value Addition.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Value Addition.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Value Addition.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fundamentals of Fisheries Management? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fundamentals of Fisheries Management.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fundamentals of Fisheries Management.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fundamentals of Fisheries Management.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Fundamentals of Fisheries Management.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fishing gears and Methods Page 12 of 33 1 STRAND 1.0: FISH BIOLOGY AND ECOLOGY S? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Fishing gears and Methods Page 12 of 33 1 STRAND 1.0: FISH BIOLOGY AND ECOLOGY S.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fishing gears and Methods Page 12 of 33 1 STRAND 1.0: FISH BIOLOGY AND ECOLOGY S.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fishing gears and Methods Page 12 of 33 1 STRAND 1.0: FISH BIOLOGY AND ECOLOGY S.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fishing gears and Methods Page 12 of 33 1 STRAND 1.0: FISH BIOLOGY AND ECOLOGY S.

10. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Milk souring
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Paper burning to ash

11. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. Any white crystal used in cooking
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. A mixture of two liquids

12. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Fundamentals of Fisheries Management 3.2. Fishing gears and Methods Page 12 of 3 and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Fundamentals of Fisheries Management and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Fishing gears and Methods Page 12 of 33 1 STRAND 1.0: FISH BIOLOGY AND ECOLOGY S and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Fishing gears and Methods and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
